walls.note: The rectified crop shows the neighbouring Spui 25 shop front (rusticated stone base, balcony, lantern), which stands in front of this west flank; the Maagdenhuis wall itself is only visible edge-on in w08. Nothing of the Maagdenhuis is claimed from this crop.

The Spui front. This 8.7 m panel is one of seven strips of the 31 m front; the elevation was read from the RCE photographs 20014425 (G.Th. Delemarre, CC BY-SA 4.0) and 20408833 (Serge Technau, CC BY-SA 4.0), UvAMaagdenhuis.jpg (Mtcv, CC BY-SA 3.0) and the 2019 panorama aimed at the door (artifacts/landmark-refs/maagdenhuis).

items.where: full-width sandstone pediment over the whole Spui front, shallow slope, heavy raking cornices, above a stone entablature
items.how: addPediment: sandstone tympanum slab laid over the 3DBAG gable face and two raking cornice beams

items.where: centre of the tympanum: a seated allegorical figure with flanking seated figures on a sweeping scroll, reclining figures at the ends
items.how: addPediment: sandstone scroll arms (boxes along a spline), central seated figure on a plinth, two flanking seated and two reclining figures from cylinders, boxes and spheres; the figures' faces, drapery and the foliage on the scrolls are not resolved in the photographs

items.where: ground storey: tall round-headed sash windows with white archivolt bands and radial heads, rectangular windows at the outer bays
items.how: kit portals (arches.ground round, stone band) in every strip of the front: the outer rectangular windows are drawn arched too, and the radial head bars are omitted

items.where: centre bay: double doorway with a double stair of two side flights up to a railed landing and a basement door under it
items.how: maagdenhuisHooks panel 33: grey landing block, two four-step flights, black posts and rails, basement door in a pale surround

items.where: semicircular radial fanlight over the entrance doors, with a central roundel
items.how: the kit's arched portal and its stone archivolt band stand for the doorway; radial tracery omitted

items.where: white stone string course running the full width of the front on top of the ground storey
items.how: maagdenhuisHooks drawBand over every strip at 6.3 m

items.where: a small stone console above every ground-floor archivolt, touching the string course
items.how: kit voussoir arch band (arches.band voussoir): imposts at the springing and a keystone block on every ground opening

items.where: two lanterns on iron brackets at the door jambs and a red cast-iron street lamp with a crown finial in front of the stair
items.how: maagdenhuisHooks: bracket lanterns on the jambs; street lamp (post, lantern, crown) at the end of addPediment
